Orbit uses ZXing.Net 0.16.11 by Michael Jahn and contributors.
ZXing.Net is a .NET port of ZXing, by the ZXing authors.
Project: https://github.com/micjahn/ZXing.Net
Package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/ZXing.Net/0.16.11
License: Apache License 2.0; see ZXing.Net-LICENSE.txt.
Original library is distributed unmodified. Orbit supplies its own WPF bitmap adapter.
